entries.title: 视觉平台钩子改写
entries.summary: 把一个核心想法改写成 3 种视觉平台高点击钩子：反直觉痛点、步骤化框架、幕后历程。
entries.prompt: 将这个核心想法 [核心产品/想法] 改写为 3 种适合视觉平台的高点击率钩子风格：(1) 反直觉痛点，(2) 步骤化框架，(3) 幕后从零到一的历程。
entries.author: Lam_Xcom

entries.title: 长内容改写成五个平台版本
entries.summary: 把一篇长内容改编成 X 帖、5 页轮播图脚本、60 秒视频脚本、WhatsApp 群发和 LinkedIn 帖子。
entries.prompt:
"Here is a piece of content I created: [paste content].

Repurpose it into:

An X post under 280 characters that captures the main insight.
A 5-slide Instagram carousel script: one hook slide, three value slides and one CTA slide.
A 60-second video script with a hook, problem, solution and CTA.
A WhatsApp broadcast under 60 words for my business audience.
A LinkedIn post of approximately 150 words, written in a professional but conversational tone and ending with a question.

Keep the original meaning, but adapt the language, structure and presentation to suit each platform. Don't simply shorten the original text or make all five versions sound alike."
entries.author: i_am_agbeke

entries.title: 聊天记录提取事项表
entries.summary: 从聊天或会议记录中提取事项、状态、负责人、时间和原话，区分已定与待定，不猜测缺失信息。
entries.prompt:
Extract: item | current status | person | time | supporting quote.
Separate confirmed, proposed, pending and cancelled. Mark explicit changes; proposals are not decisions.
Write ‘not stated’ for gaps. Do not guess dates or addresses. End with up to 3 questions still needed. Do not send messages or create events.
entries.author: UncleJAI
